claims.statement: Commodity-vessel transits through Hormuz remained far below normal in the observed weekend and AIS-visible traffic was reported around 90% below pre-conflict baselines.
Large LPG carrier movements were still observed through Hormuz, indicating constrained rather than zero LPG passage.
Sinopec said it would increase crude sourcing from Brazil, Africa and other non-Gulf routes to manage Middle East supply disruption.
Sinopec disclosed crude stocks for about 20 days of processing and refined fuel for about 15 days of sales.
Sinopec indicated lower annual crude processing needs amid weaker fuel demand, showing supply diversification does not imply aggregate demand expansion.
U.S. LNG exports were at record 2026 levels through July as disrupted Gulf supply increased reliance on alternative exporters.
High forward LNG prices create a risk of delayed purchases and demand destruction among price-sensitive buyers.
Uniper said it had filled around 70% of its contracted gas storage capacity.
An inverted summer-winter gas spread was reducing commercial incentive to inject gas into storage.
